snippet.title: Dungeon Holdem – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Every hand is a weapon. ♠️
Dungeon Holdem fuses poker, dungeon crawling and deckbuilding RPG mechanics into one bold new roguelike experience.

Stack hands, chain combos, and bend poker rules to unleash devastating attacks as you battle monsters, unlock new abilities and refine your deck with every run.

Featuring:
Strategic poker-based combat
100+ abilities and 30 consumables
20+ unique monsters
Multiple classes and upgrade paths
Master your cards. Conquer the dungeon.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3566130/Dungeon_Holdem/

#DungeonHoldem #MicroProse #Deckbuilder #IndieGame
